architecture: Unchanged V19 FrozenCommonResponse and V10 LocalTwoHead. Per seed pretrain raw-reference common motion, freeze it entirely, then train four separate raw-action anchored response cores with matched initialization and minibatch order. No mediator. Original GRU + SAME frozen common motion + response.
loss: Nonanchor paired support = valid candidate AND valid anchor AND raw commands differ. MSE=sum coordinate squares/3; L2=vector norm with torch zero subgradient at exact zero. Call means within groups or all points within groups. Full-train population weights fixed before training: Ncalls/Ngroups * 1/group_call_count for call, Ncalls/Ngroups * call_valid_point_count/group_total_valid_points for point. Minibatch mean(weight*call_loss), fixed denominator=batch_size; avoids random ratio normalization. Same .001 coordinate response energy penalty under each weighting. No label-bin gating, resampling or horizon masking.
loss_scale_limit: MSE(m²) and L2(m) have different gradients/units; optimizer settings fixed, no scale or learning-rate sweep. Factorial conclusions are for these specified training objectives and budgets, not optimizer-invariant loss geometry alone.
normalization: Fresh train public history only; std floor .01.
selection: Report final80 epochs of all3seeds for all5configurations; select ADE-median seed separately per configuration. raw_point_l2 is predeclared primary; other configurations cannot replace it posthoc as the primary success. Two independent full training runs must reproduce all15weights/optimizer/RNG/history/predictions.

decision_bootstrap.interpretation: Fixed fresh-development group-equal descriptive intervals, not untouched holdout or closed-loop control.

primary_improvement_checks: Primary raw_point_l2 additionally needs median response <= raw_call_mse AND positive selected decision-gain interval lower bound vs raw_call_mse. All four response configurations still require response-vs-zero and original complete-cost decision gates vs own motion/CV/motion_only. Failure retained, never gate-relaxed.
diagnostics: All-seed train/dev vector error, coordinate MSE, zero/1cm/5cm/20cm bins and all offsets using fixed V20 decomposition, descriptive only. Compare expanded vs actual library separately from learned response. Do not use truth bins to gate inference.
later_required: Research eligibility only. Whole module off/refusal/failure exact original equivalence, sequential/self-generated local candidates, untouched holdout, original8Levels and new-scene enhanced closed-loop capture/safety/latency remain mandatory before any promotion.
